```{r}
fliF_fasta <- read.fasta("Data/07_Split_Align_Merge/3di_FliF_RBM2.fasta")
fasta_names <- names(fliF_fasta)
accession_ids <- c()
matching_names <- c()
for (i in fasta_names) {
  name <- i
  accession_id <- strsplit(name, split = "\\.")[[1]][1]
  accession_ids <- c(accession_ids, accession_id)
}

mot_tree <- read.tree("Data/Comparing_MotA/MotAB_mBio_noSlashes.fasta.treefile")
mot_names <- mot_tree$tip.label
mot_names
mot_ids <- c()
for (i in mot_names) {
  mot_name <- i
 mot_id <- strsplit(mot_name, split = "\\_")[[1]][1]
 mot_ids <- c(mot_ids, mot_id)
}

mot_ids

for (i in accession_ids) {
  pattern <- i

# directory
dir_path <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/flag/Full_genomes/genomes"

# get all .faa files inside GCA* and GCF* directories
files <- list.files(
  dir_path,
  pattern = "protein.faa$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

# keep only GCA* or GCF* folders
files <- files[grepl("/(GCA|GCF)", files)]

# find files containing the pattern
files_with_pattern <- files[
  sapply(files, function(f) {
    any(grepl(pattern, readLines(f, warn = FALSE)))
  })
]

files_with_pattern 

for(j in seq_along(files_with_pattern)){

  fasta <- read.fasta(files_with_pattern[j], seqtype="AA", as.string=TRUE)
  for (k in mot_ids) {
  idx <- grep(k, names(fasta), ignore.case=TRUE)
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    matching_name <- paste0(i,"_",k)
    matching_names <- c(matching_names, matching_name)
      }
    
  }
}
}
write.csv(matching_names, "Data/Comparing_MotA/matching_names.csv")
```

```{r}
## Renaming_Tree
mot_tree <- read.tree("Data/Comparing_MotA/MotAB_mBio_noSlashes.fasta.treefile")
xlsfn = "Data/Comparing_MotA/matching_names.xlsx"
mapping  = openxlsx::read.xlsx(xlsxFile=xlsfn, sheet=1, startRow=1, colNames=TRUE)

accession <- mapping$Mot_Name
common_name <- mapping$Name


# get tree tip names
tips <- mot_tree$tip.label

# extract accession from tree tip (before underscore or dot if needed)
tip_accession <- sapply(strsplit(tips, "_"), `[`, 1)

# match accession with excel
match_index <- match(tip_accession, accession)

# create new names
new_names <- paste0(common_name[match_index])

# replace tree labels
mot_tree$tip.label <- new_names

# save new tree
write.tree(mot_tree, file = "Data/Comparing_MotA/MotAB_renamed.tree")
```

```{r}
library(ape)
library(readxl)

tree <- read.tree("Data/Comparing_MotA/MotAB_mBio_noSlashes.fasta.treefile")
mapping <- read_excel("Data/Comparing_MotA/matching_names.xlsx")

tips <- tree$tip.label

tip_accession <- sapply(strsplit(tips, "_"), `[`, 1)

match_index <- match(tip_accession, mapping$Mot_Name)

species <- mapping$Name[match_index]

tips_to_remove <- tips[is.na(species)]

tree <- drop.tip(tree, tips_to_remove)

tips <- tree$tip.label
tip_accession <- sapply(strsplit(tips, "_"), `[`, 1)

match_index <- match(tip_accession, mapping$Mot_Name)
species <- mapping$Name[match_index]

tree$tip.label <- paste0(species)

write.tree(tree, "Data/Comparing_MotA/MotAB_cleaned_renamed.tree")
```

```{r}
library(ape)
library(readxl)

flif_tree <- read.nexus("Data/Comparing_MotA/FliF.treefile")


mapping <- read_excel("Data/Comparing_MotA/matching_names.xlsx")

tips <- flif_tree$tip.label
tips <- gsub("'", "", tips)

tip_accession <- sapply(strsplit(tips, "\\."), `[`, 1)

match_index <- match(tip_accession, mapping$FliF_Name)

species <- mapping$Name[match_index]

tips_to_remove <- tips[is.na(species)]

flif_tree <- drop.tip(flif_tree, tips_to_remove)
# recalculate after dropping tips
tips <- flif_tree$tip.label
tips <- gsub("'", "", tips)
tips
tip_accession <- sapply(strsplit(tips, "\\."), `[`, 1)
match_index <- match(tip_accession, mapping$FliF_Name)
species <- mapping$Name[match_index]
species
flif_tree$tip.label <- species

write.tree(flif_tree, "Data/Comparing_MotA/FliF_renamed.tree")
```

##########################################
```{r}
# ============================================================
# TANGLEGRAM WORKFLOW IN R
# ============================================================
#
# Handles:
# - Two protein accession columns
# - Comma-separated multiple accessions per row
# - Corresponding rows are linked in tanglegram
#
# Example:
#
# Protein1                Protein2
# XP_001,XP_002           YP_900
# XP_003                  YP_901,YP_902
#
# XP_001 and XP_002 both connect to YP_900
# XP_003 connects to YP_901 and YP_902
#
# ============================================================
# REQUIRED PACKAGES
# ============================================================

## install.packages(c("ape", "phytools"))

#library(ape)
#library(phytools)

# ============================================================
# INPUT FILES
# ============================================================

mapping_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/motA_FliF_grand_table.txt"

tree1_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/FliF_spoRoot.newick"
tree2_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/MotAB_mBio_noSlashes.fasta.treefile"

# Column names
protein1_column <- "FliF_IDs_matching_motA_genomes_list_txt"
protein2_column <- "mota_ids"

# Output files
trimmed_tree1_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/trimmed_FliF.nwk"
trimmed_tree2_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/trimmed_MotAB.nwk"

tanglegram_output <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/tanglegram.pdf"

# ============================================================
# STEP 1: READ MAPPING FILE
# ============================================================

df <- read.table(
  mapping_file,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Remove NA rows
df <- df[
  !is.na(df[[protein1_column]]) &
  !is.na(df[[protein2_column]]),
]

cat("Rows loaded:", nrow(df), "\n")

# ============================================================
# STEP 2: EXPAND ACCESSION PAIRS
# ============================================================

protein1_all <- c()
protein2_all <- c()

pair_ids_1 <- c()
pair_ids_2 <- c()

for(i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

  # Split comma-separated accessions
  p1 <- unlist(strsplit(df[[protein1_column]][i], ","))
  p2 <- unlist(strsplit(df[[protein2_column]][i], ","))

  # Clean whitespace
  p1 <- trimws(p1)
  p2 <- trimws(p2)

  # Store all accessions
  protein1_all <- c(protein1_all, p1)
  protein2_all <- c(protein2_all, p2)

  # Create shared pair IDs
  #
  # All accessions in same row share same ID
  #
  pair_id <- paste0("pair_", i)

  pair_ids_1 <- c(pair_ids_1, rep(pair_id, length(p1)))
  pair_ids_2 <- c(pair_ids_2, rep(pair_id, length(p2)))
}

# ============================================================
# STEP 3: LOAD TREES
# ============================================================

tree1 <- read.tree(tree1_file)
tree2 <- read.tree(tree2_file)

if(class(tree1) == "multiPhylo") {
  tree1 <- tree1[[1]]
}

if(class(tree2) == "multiPhylo") {
  tree2 <- tree2[[1]]
}

tree1$tip.label <- sub("_.*", "", tree1$tip.label)
tree2$tip.label <- sub("_.*", "", tree2$tip.label)


# ============================================================
# STEP 4: TRIM TREES
# ============================================================

tree1_trimmed <- keep.tip(
  tree1,
  tree1$tip.label[
    tree1$tip.label %in% protein1_all
  ]
)

tree2_trimmed <- keep.tip(
  tree2,
  tree2$tip.label[
    tree2$tip.label %in% protein2_all
  ]
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 5: RENAME TIPS USING PAIR IDS
# ============================================================
#
# cophylo requires identical names to connect.
#
# Since multiple accessions may belong to same pair,
# make unique labels:
#
# pair_1_1
# pair_1_2
#
# ============================================================

# Rename Tree 1 tips
counter <- list()

for(i in seq_along(protein1_all)) {

  old_name <- protein1_all[i]
  pair_id <- pair_ids_1[i]

  if(is.null(counter[[pair_id]])) {
    counter[[pair_id]] <- 1
  } else {
    counter[[pair_id]] <- counter[[pair_id]] + 1
  }

  new_name <- paste0(pair_id, "_", counter[[pair_id]])

  tree1_trimmed$tip.label[
    tree1_trimmed$tip.label == old_name
  ] <- new_name
}

# Rename Tree 2 tips
counter <- list()

for(i in seq_along(protein2_all)) {

  old_name <- protein2_all[i]
  pair_id <- pair_ids_2[i]

  if(is.null(counter[[pair_id]])) {
    counter[[pair_id]] <- 1
  } else {
    counter[[pair_id]] <- counter[[pair_id]] + 1
  }

  new_name <- paste0(pair_id, "_", counter[[pair_id]])

  tree2_trimmed$tip.label[
    tree2_trimmed$tip.label == old_name
  ] <- new_name
}

# ============================================================
# STEP 6: KEEP ONLY MATCHING LABELS
# ============================================================

common_labels <- intersect(
  tree1_trimmed$tip.label,
  tree2_trimmed$tip.label
)

#tree1_trimmed <- keep.tip(tree1_trimmed, common_labels)
#tree2_trimmed <- keep.tip(tree2_trimmed, common_labels)

cat("Matching labels:", length(common_labels), "\n")

# ============================================================
# STEP 7: SAVE TRIMMED TREES
# ============================================================

write.tree(tree1_trimmed, file = trimmed_tree1_file)
write.tree(tree2_trimmed, file = trimmed_tree2_file)

# ============================================================
# STEP 8: CREATE TANGLEGRAM
# ============================================================

pdf(tanglegram_output, width = 14, height = 18)

cophylo_obj <- cophylo(
  tree1_trimmed,
  tree2_trimmed,
  rotate = TRUE
)

plot(
  cophylo_obj,
  link.type = "curved",
  link.lwd = 1,
  fsize = 0.6
)

title("Tanglegram with Multiple Corresponding Accessions")

dev.off()

cat("Tanglegram saved as:", tanglegram_output, "\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# TANGLEGRAM WORKFLOW IN R
# ============================================================
#
# Features:
# - Two accession columns
# - Comma-separated multiple accessions
# - Corresponding rows linked together
# - Tree labels trimmed after first underscore
# - INTERNAL matching names used for cophylo
# - ORIGINAL accession names restored before plotting
#
# ============================================================
# REQUIRED PACKAGES
# ============================================================

# install.packages(c("ape", "phytools"))

library(ape)
library(phytools)

# ============================================================
# INPUT FILES
# ============================================================

mapping_file <- "accession_pairs.txt"

mapping_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/motA_FliF_grand_table.txt"

tree1_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/FliF_spoRoot.newick"
tree2_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/MotAB_mBio_noSlashes.fasta.treefile"

# Column names
protein1_column <- "FliF_IDs_matching_motA_genomes_list_txt"
protein2_column <- "mota_ids"

# Output files
trimmed_tree1_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/trimmed_FliF.nwk"
trimmed_tree2_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/trimmed_MotAB.nwk"

tanglegram_output <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/tanglegram2.pdf"

# ============================================================
# STEP 1: READ MAPPING FILE
# ============================================================

df <- read.table(
  mapping_file,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

df <- df[
  !is.na(df[[protein1_column]]) &
  !is.na(df[[protein2_column]]),
]

cat("Rows loaded:", nrow(df), "\n")

# ============================================================
# STEP 2: EXPAND ACCESSION PAIRS
# ============================================================

protein1_all <- c()
protein2_all <- c()

pair_ids_1 <- c()
pair_ids_2 <- c()

for(i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

  p1 <- unlist(strsplit(df[[protein1_column]][i], ","))
  p2 <- unlist(strsplit(df[[protein2_column]][i], ","))

  p1 <- trimws(p1)
  p2 <- trimws(p2)

  protein1_all <- c(protein1_all, p1)
  protein2_all <- c(protein2_all, p2)

  pair_id <- paste0("pair_", i)

  pair_ids_1 <- c(pair_ids_1, rep(pair_id, length(p1)))
  pair_ids_2 <- c(pair_ids_2, rep(pair_id, length(p2)))
}

# ============================================================
# STEP 3: LOAD TREES
# ============================================================

tree1 <- read.tree(tree1_file)
tree2 <- read.tree(tree2_file)

# Handle multiple trees
if(inherits(tree1, "multiPhylo")) {
  tree1 <- tree1[[1]]
}

if(inherits(tree2, "multiPhylo")) {
  tree2 <- tree2[[1]]
}

# ============================================================
# STEP 4: TRIM TREE LABELS AFTER FIRST UNDERSCORE
# ============================================================
#
# Example:
# ABC_XP001_extra -> ABC
#
# If you instead want:
# XP001_extra
#
# use:
# sub("^[^_]*_", "", x)
#
# ============================================================

tree1$tip.label <- sub("_.*", "", tree1$tip.label)
tree2$tip.label <- sub("_.*", "", tree2$tip.label)

# ============================================================
# STEP 5: TRIM TREES
# ============================================================

tree1_trimmed <- keep.tip(
  tree1,
  tree1$tip.label %in% protein1_all
)

tree2_trimmed <- keep.tip(
  tree2,
  tree2$tip.label %in% protein2_all
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 6: CREATE SAFE RENAME MAPS
# ============================================================

rename_map_tree1 <- c()
rename_map_tree2 <- c()

counter <- list()

# Tree1 rename map
for(i in seq_along(protein1_all)) {

  old_name <- protein1_all[i]
  pair_id <- pair_ids_1[i]

  if(is.null(counter[[pair_id]])) {
    counter[[pair_id]] <- 1
  } else {
    counter[[pair_id]] <- counter[[pair_id]] + 1
  }

  temp_name <- paste0(pair_id, "_", counter[[pair_id]])

  rename_map_tree1[old_name] <- temp_name
}

# Tree2 rename map
counter <- list()

for(i in seq_along(protein2_all)) {

  old_name <- protein2_all[i]
  pair_id <- pair_ids_2[i]

  if(is.null(counter[[pair_id]])) {
    counter[[pair_id]] <- 1
  } else {
    counter[[pair_id]] <- counter[[pair_id]] + 1
  }

  temp_name <- paste0(pair_id, "_", counter[[pair_id]])

  rename_map_tree2[old_name] <- temp_name
}

# ============================================================
# STEP 7: APPLY RENAMING SAFELY
# ============================================================

# Store original labels
original_labels_tree1 <- rename_map_tree1
original_labels_tree2 <- rename_map_tree2

# Rename tips
tree1_trimmed$tip.label <-
  rename_map_tree1[tree1_trimmed$tip.label]

tree2_trimmed$tip.label <-
  rename_map_tree2[tree2_trimmed$tip.label]

# Remove NA tips if present
valid1 <- !is.na(tree1_trimmed$tip.label)
valid2 <- !is.na(tree2_trimmed$tip.label)

tree1_trimmed <- keep.tip(
  tree1_trimmed,
  tree1_trimmed$tip.label[valid1]
)

tree2_trimmed <- keep.tip(
  tree2_trimmed,
  tree2_trimmed$tip.label[valid2]
)

# Keep common labels only
common_labels <- intersect(
  tree1_trimmed$tip.label,
  tree2_trimmed$tip.label
)

# tree1_trimmed <- keep.tip(tree1_trimmed, common_labels)
# tree2_trimmed <- keep.tip(tree2_trimmed, common_labels)

cat("Matching labels:", length(common_labels), "\n")

# ============================================================
# STEP 8: SAVE TRIMMED TREES
# ============================================================

write.tree(tree1_trimmed, file = trimmed_tree1_file)
write.tree(tree2_trimmed, file = trimmed_tree2_file)

# ============================================================
# STEP 9: CREATE COPHYLO OBJECT
# ============================================================

cophylo_obj <- cophylo(
  tree1_trimmed,
  tree2_trimmed,
  rotate = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 10: RESTORE ORIGINAL LABELS
# ============================================================

cophylo_obj$trees[[1]]$tip.label <-
  original_labels_tree1[
    cophylo_obj$trees[[1]]$tip.label
  ]

cophylo_obj$trees[[2]]$tip.label <-
  original_labels_tree2[
    cophylo_obj$trees[[2]]$tip.label
  ]

# ============================================================
# STEP 11: PLOT TANGLEGRAM
# ============================================================

pdf(tanglegram_output, width = 14, height = 18)

plot(
  cophylo_obj,
  link.type = "curved",
  link.lwd = 1,
  fsize = 0.6
)

title("Tanglegram with Original Accession Labels")

dev.off()

cat("Tanglegram saved as:", tanglegram_output, "\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# COPHYLO / TANGLEGRAM USING ASSOCIATION MATRIX ONLY
# (NO RENAMING, NO TREE TRIMMING)
# ============================================================

# install.packages(c("ape", "phytools"))

library(ape)
library(phytools)

# ============================================================
# INPUT FILES
# ============================================================

mapping_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/motA_FliF_grand_table.txt"

tree1_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/FliF_spoRoot.newick"
tree2_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/MotAB_mBio_noSlashes.fasta.treefile"

# Column names
protein1_column <- "FliF_IDs_matching_motA_genomes_list_txt"
protein2_column <- "mota_ids"

# Output files
trimmed_tree1_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/trimmed_FliF.nwk"
trimmed_tree2_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/trimmed_MotAB.nwk"

tanglegram_output <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/tanglegram2.pdf"

# ============================================================
# STEP 1: READ MAPPING FILE
# ============================================================

df <- read.table(
  mapping_file,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

df <- df[
  !is.na(df[[protein1_column]]) &
  !is.na(df[[protein2_column]]),
]

cat("Rows loaded:", nrow(df), "\n")

# ============================================================
# STEP 2: EXPAND COMMA-SEPARATED ENTRIES
# ============================================================

pairs <- data.frame(
  tree1 = character(),
  tree2 = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

  p1 <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(df[[protein1_column]][i], ",")))
  p2 <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(df[[protein2_column]][i], ",")))

  for(a in p1) {
    for(b in p2) {

      pairs <- rbind(
        pairs,
        data.frame(tree1 = a, tree2 = b)
      )
    }
  }
}

cat("Total association pairs:", nrow(pairs), "\n")

# ============================================================
# STEP 3: LOAD TREES (DO NOT MODIFY)
# ============================================================

tree1 <- read.tree(tree1_file)
tree2 <- read.tree(tree2_file)

if(inherits(tree1, "multiPhylo")) tree1 <- tree1[[1]]
if(inherits(tree2, "multiPhylo")) tree2 <- tree2[[1]]

# ============================================================
# STEP 4: EXTRACT ACCESSION FROM TREE LABELS
# (before first underscore)
# ============================================================

extract_id <- function(x) sub("_.*", "", x)

tree1_ids <- extract_id(tree1$tip.label)
tree2_ids <- extract_id(tree2$tip.label)

names(tree1_ids) <- tree1$tip.label
names(tree2_ids) <- tree2$tip.label

# ============================================================
# STEP 5: BUILD EDGE LIST (NOT MATRIX)
# ============================================================

assoc_list <- data.frame(
  t1 = character(),
  t2 = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(i in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {

  p1 <- pairs$tree1[i]
  p2 <- pairs$tree2[i]

  t1_hits <- names(tree1_ids)[tree1_ids == p1]
  t2_hits <- names(tree2_ids)[tree2_ids == p2]

  if(length(t1_hits) == 0 || length(t2_hits) == 0) next

  # create all combinations
  for(a in t1_hits) {
    for(b in t2_hits) {

      assoc_list <- rbind(
        assoc_list,
        data.frame(t1 = a, t2 = b)
      )
    }
  }
}

cat("Valid associations:", nrow(assoc_list), "\n")

# remove duplicates (IMPORTANT)
assoc_list <- unique(assoc_list)

# ============================================================
# STEP 6: CREATE COPHYLO OBJECT (SAFE VERSION)
# ============================================================

cophylo_obj <- cophylo(
  tree1,
  tree2,
  assoc = assoc_list,
  rotate = TRUE
)
# ============================================================
# STEP 7: PLOT TANGLEGRAM
# ============================================================

pdf(tanglegram_output, width = 14, height = 18)

plot(
  cophylo_obj,
  link.type = "curved",
  link.lwd = 0.4,
  fsize = 0.1
)


title("Tanglegram Using Association Matrix (No Tree Modification)")

dev.off()

cat("Saved:", tanglegram_output, "\n")

plot(tree2)

write.csv(assoc_list, "Data/Comparing_MotA/AssociationList.csv")
```


```{r}
library(ape)

# Read tree
tree <- read.tree("Data/Comparing_MotA/FliF_spoRoot.newick")

# Read CSV
tips_df <- read.csv("Data/Comparing_MotA/AssociationList.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Extract tips to keep
tips_to_keep <- tips_df$t1

# Check which requested tips are missing from the tree
missing_tips <- setdiff(tips_to_keep, tree$tip.label)

if (length(missing_tips) > 0) {
cat("Tips not found in tree:\n")
print(missing_tips)
}

# Prune tree to retain only tips in the CSV
tree_pruned <- keep.tip(tree, intersect(tips_to_keep, tree$tip.label))

# Save pruned tree
write.tree(tree_pruned, file = "Data/Comparing_MotA/trimmed_FliF.nwk")

# Summary
cat("Original tips:", Ntip(tree), "\n")
cat("Pruned tips:", Ntip(tree_pruned), "\n")
```

```{r}
tree1_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/trimmed_FliF.nwk"
tree2_file <- "Data/Comparing_MotA/trimmed_MotAB.nwk"

tree1 <- read.tree(tree1_file)
tree2 <- read.tree(tree2_file)

cophylo_obj <- cophylo(
```
